editorial.blurb: Gibson's Italia delivers exceptional steaks and Italian-American cuisine in a stunning rooftop setting with impeccable service that keeps regulars coming back week after week.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the New York Strip cooked Pittsburgh style or the Filet—regulars swear by these steaks paired with the mushrooms and baked potato. Make a reservation well in advance, especially for special occasions.
